jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
 

 We are currently looking to add a Product Manager to join our new Munich, Germany office, specifically within the Product Engineering Group. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and managing our technical products, working with our team to define and deliver solutions that support our mission of seamless, out-of-the-box space communication systems. 

 

 As a Product Manager at CesiumAstro, you will be at the forefront of managing the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through to customer integration and support for the European market. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing to develop product strategies that align with our customer needs and business objectives. This role requires a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen, enabling you to drive product decisions and ensure customer success in highly technical environments. 

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Work closely with senior leadership and engineering teams to define product strategies, ensuring alignment with CesiumAstro’s business objectives and customer needs. 

 Contribute to the development of product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market trends, customer feedback, and technological advancements. 

 Act as a liaison between product engineering, business development/sales, marketing, and customer support teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer expectations. 

 Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across teams to drive product development cycles. 

 Engage directly with customers to understand their technical needs, challenges, and goals. Leverage this insight to inform product decisions and ensure that solutions meet customer expectations. 

 Oversee the launch of new products and features, working with the marketing team to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction. 

 Provide technical leadership and customer-facing support as needed to ensure smooth product integrations. 

 Lead the identification and implementation of continuous improvements for products and processes, ensuring that CesiumAstro’s products remain industry-leading and meet the evolving demands of our customers. 

 Create and maintain high-quality documentation, including user manuals, application notes, and white papers. 

 Ensure that customer-facing teams are well-equipped with the knowledge to support product offerings. 

 JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a relevant technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related discipline. 

 At least 7 years of experience in the design of communication electronics, technical product development, product management, or application support. 

 In-depth understanding of RF electronics, communication systems, and associated technologies such as digital systems, embedded software, FPGAs, and power electronics. 

 Proven experience working with technical customers, developing strong relationships, and translating their needs into actionable product requirements. 

 Working knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ or Python. 

 Exceptional troubleshooting skills and ability to understand, diagnose, and solve complex product issues across hardware and software domains. 

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

 Experience with high-reliability electronics and systems, particularly in the aerospace industry. 

 Familiarity with small satellite systems and their unique requirements 

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE 

 Background in technical sales, marketing, or customer solution development is a plus.

 Experience in crafting technical solutions for customer proposals, demonstrating an understanding of customer requirements and aligning product capabilities accordingly.

 CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.
 

 Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligate

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.

Structured self-starter
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.

Analytical thinker
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.

Customer-curious
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.

Clear communicator
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.

Scrappy generalist
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".

AI-native
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.

Has taste
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".

Language
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who We Don't Want 

  • You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
  • You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
  • You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
  • You get defensive when receiving feedback
  • You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

Your Day to Day 

Strategic Projects (~25%)

  • Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
  • Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)

  • Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
  • Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marke

Location: Chancery Lane, London (Office-based 4 days) 
 
 The Mission
 At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.
 We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.
 We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.
 You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.
 
 What you will own
 You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.
 Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

 Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

 Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

 Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

 Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

 Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

 Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

 Who you are
 You are a full-stack product thinker.
 Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

 Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

 Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

 Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

 Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

 The Role
 You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.
 You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.
 You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.
 You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.
 If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.
 
 Why Fyxer?
 We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.
 Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

 Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

 Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager (German-speaking)
jobs.description:
About BoWatt
 BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.
 
 We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.
 
 We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.
 
 You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.
 
 The role
 As our Founding Product Manager, you will help determine what BoWatt builds, why we build it, and whether it creates meaningful value for customers.
 
 You will work closely across our commercial, customer success and engineering teams, as well as with our customers. You will develop a deep understanding of complex engineering workflows, turn customer problems into clear product opportunities, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
 
 This is a hands-on product role. You will spend time with customers, work through technical and operational detail, write requirements, make trade-offs, test solutions, and help the team ship quickly.

 Develop deep expertise in BoWatt’s product, customers, and target industries

 You

jobs.title: Product Owner Hardware (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What We're Building Towards
 At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.
 Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.
 We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

 What We're Looking For
 We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.
 Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.
 You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

 What You'll Build
 Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

 Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

 Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

 Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

 Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

 Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

 Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

 Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

 Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.

 Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.

 Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.

 Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.

 After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.
 
 How we work
 Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.

 Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly.

 Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.

 AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?
 

 What you bring
 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on

 Deliver customer-specific integrations and workflows for some of the largest health organisations in the country, coordinating across engineering teams you don't own

 Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits . 

 

 Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. 

 

 Profil recherché : 

 - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur , entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. 

 - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business , avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. 

 - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. 

 - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions (Premium Desirability)
jobs.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

 The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

 This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

 What You Will Do 

 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Premium awareness, acquisition, and activation, helping more listeners discover its value and take the next step toward subscribing.

 Lead the discovery, development, and launch of consumer-facing product experiences, from early ideas and testing through to global rollout.

 Shape how people experience Premium across Spotify and partner channels, creating engaging journeys that build consideration, encourage subscription, and support long-term retention.

 Collaborate with partnerships and commercial teams to develop, launch, and scale subscription offerings across partners, markets, and audience segments.

 Lead experimentation to understand what drives interest in Premium, using A/B testing and behavioral insights to improve the user journey and measure business impact.

 Turn customer insights, market trends, and performance data into clear product opportunities, measurable goals, and informed priorities.

 Balance user needs, business outcomes, partner requirements, and regional differences to make thoughtful product decisions that deliver sustainable growth.

 Bring teams together around a shared direction, communicating product strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.

 Where You'll Be 

 You have a strong track record in product management, building and launching consumer-facing products at scale, with experience in areas such as subscriptions, consumer growth, marketplaces, media, or partner ecosystems.

 You understand what makes a product valuable to consumers and how product experiences, positioning, and messaging influence consideration and willingness to pay.

 You know how to identify opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and retention, and connect product decisions to subscriber and revenue growth.

 You're confident designing experiments, interpreting A/B tests, and using funnel, cohort, and behavioral data to make informed product decisions.

 You have experience working across different markets and customer segments, balancing globally consistent experiences with local needs and opportunities.

 You bring sound product judgment, knowing when to improve an existing experience, explore a new approach, or invest in longer-term capabilities.

 You're a thoughtful communicator and collaborative partner who can bring together diverse perspectives, influence decisions, and align cross-functional teams around shared goals.

 You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing assumptions, learning from outcomes, and adapting your approach as new insights emerge.

 Where You Will Be 

 This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build a new product offering that brings together Kpler's vessel, ownership, port, and trade-flow data to address growing challenges around seafood supply chain transparency and illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing.

 Own the Fisheries product strategy, vision, and roadmap , defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Domain experience in market intelligence, news, financial research, or another data-heavy industry.
  • Background at a data provider, enrichment vendor, market intelligence platform, or vertical search company, or experience building vertical data products in-house.
  • Experience evaluating and working with external data providers, including judging quality and negotiating what you actually need.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands. 

Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.

As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences
  • Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads
  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team
  • Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development
  • 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams
  • You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.
  • Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Private Pension plan with Employer-matching
  • 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan
  • Income Replacement Programs
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

 We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

 Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

 
 
 About This Role: 

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

 This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

 We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

 
 Our Benefits: 

 At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

 
 A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

 A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

 A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

 Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

 Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

 Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

 The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

 A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

 
 *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. 

 
 Responsibilities: 

 In this role, you will:

 
 Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.

 Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

 Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.

 Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.

 Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.

 Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.

 Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 
 
 Your Profile: 

 
 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.

 A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.

 Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.

 Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

 Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.

 Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product 

 Our mission for you

 European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.
 trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.
 

 We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.
 trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

 We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

 Your team

 You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

 You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

 Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.
 Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.
 Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

 Who we are looking for

 Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.
 Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.
 Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.
 Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.
 Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.
 AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.
 Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.
 At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

 
90 Day Goals

 After 6 Weeks (Onboarding)

 High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.
 We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

 You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

 Work daily with product managers and design engineers.
 
 Requirements 
 
 Background & Experience

 Persuasive communicator at eye level with enterprise customers and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork

jobs.title: AI Product Manager Intern - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As an AI Product Manager Intern at Reonic, you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and our customers.

You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process.

This is not a coffee-run internship: you’ll take on real ownership from day one and work closely with engineers and other teams to improve both our product and the way we build and release it.

 Please note: This is a fully onsite internship in Augsburg for 4–6 months. 

 What you’ll do 
 Support release testing: Help coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and give clear, actionable feedback to engineering.

 Help coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams.

 Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience.

 Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate and reproduce issues, and translate your findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering.

 Communicate what’s new: Write release notes, help run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works.

 Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers.

 Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to contribute to better product decisions.

 
 What makes you a great fit 
 Product mindset: You naturally think beyond checklists. You want to understand why something is being built, who it is for, and what makes it useful.

 Attention to detail: You spot inconsistencies, edge cases, and potential issues before they become customer problems.

 Strong communication: You communicate clearly with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders. Professional fluency in English (C1+) is required.

 Technical curiosity: You enjoy understanding how software works and aren’t afraid to dig into technical details, investigate bugs, or learn new concepts.

 Hands-on with AI tools: Coding isn’t required, but you’ve already vibe-coded a thing or two. You can quickly build a rough prototype to show engineers how a more complex feature could work, so they get a clear picture before the real build starts.

 Customer orientation: You care about the experience of the people using the product and can turn qualitative feedback into actionable insights.

 Ownership: You take responsibility, follow things through, and don’t wait for someone else to solve a problem you can help solve yourself.

 Startup mindset: You’re comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and processes are still being built.

 Student status: You’re currently enrolled at a university and available full-time for 4–6 months. A background in economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field is helpful, but not required.

 Nice to have: First experience through internships, working student jobs, or university projects in product management, product operations, QA, software development, or B2B SaaS.

 
 Why join us? 
 Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

 A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, so your work will reach real users.

 Learn fast: Get hands-on experience in product management at a fast-growing startup, with close mentorship from our product and engineering team.

 High ownership: Nothing is set in stone. You’ll have room to shape how we work and how the product evolves, even as an intern.

 A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

 Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

 Fair compensation: We offer a competitive internship salary.

 Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn’t hold you back. We value talent and passion above all.
 
 About Reonic 
At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.
Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses, from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.
Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.
 
 Location & duration 
This is a full-time, on-site internship based in Augsburg for 4–6 months .
 
 Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager D365 CRM
jobs.description:
Digitale transformatie is pas echt succesvol wanneer strategie, technologie en mensen samenkomen. Als Senior Projectmanager bij HSO leid jij CRM-implementaties die organisaties helpen beter met hun klanten te werken. Je werkt met de nieuwste Microsoft Cloud-technologie en stuurt teams aan in uitdagende projecten. Daarbij combineer je overzicht, leiderschap en inhoudelijke betrokkenheid. Zo maak jij het verschil tussen een systeem implementeren en echte businessimpact realiseren

Taken
- Als Senior Projectmanager leid je Dynamics 365 CRM-implementaties bij onze klanten van start tot succesvolle livegang. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de voortgang, kwaliteit, scope en het budget van je projecten, en zorgt dat teams en stakeholders steeds dezelfde koers varen.
- Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Samen met de klant vertaal je strategische doelen naar een duidelijke projectaanpak en een haalbare roadmap. Je begeleidt workshops, structureert requirements en zorgt dat CRM-processen zoals sales, marketing en service effectief worden ondersteund door Dynamics 365.
- Binnen het project stuur je een multidisciplinair team van (business) consultants, developers en solution architects aan. Je houdt overzicht over planning en afhankelijkheden, stuurt actief op risico’s en zorgt dat beslissingen tijdig worden genomen. Daarbij weet je complexe trajecten te structureren en verwachtingen van stakeholders op verschillende niveaus te managen.
- Onze projecten maken vaak deel uit van bredere Microsoft Cloud-transformaties, waarbij oplossingen zoals Dynamics 365 CRM, Field Service en Power BI samenkomen. In deze omgeving zorg jij voor structuur, richting en resultaat – en help je klanten niet alleen een systeem te implementeren, maar hun manier van werken daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.

Vereisten
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met CRM-implementaties als Projectmanager - dit is essentieel!
- Je deelt onze mindset: kritisch denken, ondernemend zijn en resultaatgericht werken.
- Uitstekende beheersing van het Engels voor internationale projecten.
- Jouw managementvaardigheden zijn consultatief, anticiperend en inspirerend, waardoor het team effectief functioneert.
- Ervaring met het Microsoft-platform, met name Dynamics 365 CRM, is een pre.
- Aantoonbare kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, zoals PRINCE2, PMI of IPMA C/D-certificering.

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden:
- Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;   
- 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;   
- Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal); 
- EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;   
- Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;   
En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   

Ben jij klaar om grootschalige Microsoft-applicatieprojecten te leiden? Sluit je aan bij ons team als Senior Projectmanager D365 CRM.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team. You will own how DataSnipper’s products are understood and chosen in a crowded AI landscape. You will be the voice of competition, the buyer, and the message across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product. You will join a small Product Marketing team where your work directly affects pipeline growth globally.
 
 About DataSnipper 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.
 Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Competitive Intelligence
 Own competitive intelligence end-to-end: track competitors, draft the insight, and turn it into positioning.

 Build and maintain battlecards, objection handling, and playbooks for Sales and Marketing.

 Partner closely with Sales and Product leadership to ensure content is used, measurable, and effective.

 Set up a feedback loop between Sales, Marketing, and Product, and bring market input into roadmap discussions.

 Buyer Personas
 Create and maintain buyer personas for our key audiences.

 Ground them in customer research, win-loss, and sales input. Keep them current.

 Work with Sales to sharpen ICP and qualification criteria.

 Messaging
 Evolve product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that set us apart from competitors.

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value.

 Keep messaging consistent across web, content, campaigns, and sales.
 

 What Success Looks Like 
 Sales teams are fully equipped with enablement content they actually use.

 Product messaging is consistent and clearly different from competitors.

 Personas and messaging reflect what we hear in the market.

 DataSnipper’s value proposition becomes easier to understand, harder to compete with, and stronger across all channels.
 

 What You Bring 
 6–8 years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing, ideally within a scale-up.

 Proven competitive intelligence and positioning work that helped win deals.

 Experience building battlecards and sales content that teams use.

 Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear customer value stories and compelling narratives.

 Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a sharp eye for storytelling, structure, and clarity.

 Nice to have: audit, finance, or other regulated-industry buyers.
 

 What We Offer 
 Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

 Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

 Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

 Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

 Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

 NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

 Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

 Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

 Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

 Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

  
 Recruitment Process 
 Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

 Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes, online)

 Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site)

 Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

  
 At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. 
 Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded

jobs.title: Product Manager Digital Platforms
jobs.description:
🌊 Who are we? 
 
We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.
 
 About the role
 AURA is the platform Aquablu runs on. It replaced about 15 tools with one system of record, gives every colleague their own AI agent, and connects to hundreds of our systems in the field. Version 2.0 just went live. What it becomes next is your call.
 
 You own AURA’s direction: what gets built, why, and in what order. Then you build it yourself. You’ll write features with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor, and deploy them to production. Our engineering team sets the architecture, reviews your work, and makes sure the platform stays safe while you move fast.
 
 You don’t need to have been an engineer. You do need to want to ship code. You’ll report to our Head of Digital Product.
 
 What you'll Do
 Own the roadmap: prioritize by business value and user pain. Kill ideas that don’t earn their place.

 Find the real problem: work directly with the teams who use AURA every day.

 Build features yourself: go from idea to working feature with AI, not to a spec handed off to someone else.

 Deploy to production: ship your own features, with engineers reviewing and guiding your work.

 Keep leadership aligned: explain your priorities and trade-offs from decision to launch.

 Measure and iterate: define success for every feature, check whether it landed, and go again.

 
 What You Bring
 Platform experience: three to five years as a PM on a live software product, ideally B2B, SaaS, or internal platforms.

 Clear judgment: you commit when there’s no perfect answer.

 Stakeholder trust: you earn it with senior stakeholders and explain decisions plainly.

 Technical comfort: you’re comfortable with code, data models, and integrations, even if engineering was never your title.

 AI already in your work: you’ve built something with AI tools, even a prototype or side project, and you want to make it your day job.

 Bonus: connected hardware or IoT experience.
 
 ✨ Why join us? 
 You will be part of a young, fun and ambitious team which aims to change the way people consume water!

 💪 Urban Sports Club membership
 🚀 Access to the Corporate Benefits platform for endless savings
 🚆 Travel compensation >10km
 👴 A pension plan by Zwitserleven.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Product and GTM Enablement
jobs.description:
About the Role 
  
 We are looking for a Senior Manager - Product & GTM Enablement to lead and grow our Revenue Enablement function. You will own our enablement strategy and lead a team of two, ensuring the entire Revenue organization is equipped to sell, implement, and support DataSnipper with confidence.

 You will be the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, and our Revenue organization, ensuring that every new product release, capability update, and strategic shift is understood, internalized, and actionable by our field teams. You will work closely with PMs and the broader Product team to translate roadmap developments into role-specific enablement that reaches leaders, managers, and individual contributors alike.

 This role requires someone who can operate autonomously, manage and develop a small team, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment without sacrificing quality or alignment.
  
  
 About DataSnipper 
  
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

 We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

 Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 
 What You Will Do
 
 Team Leadership and Management
 Lead, manage, and develop a team of two Enablement Managers, setting clear goals, providing regular coaching, and creating space for them to grow

 Own the team's roadmap and prioritization, ensuring work is aligned to the highest-leverage opportunities across the Revenue organization

 Operate autonomously with strong judgment on when to escalate versus drive independently

 Product Enablement and GTM Readiness
 Partner closely with Product Managers and Product Marketing to stay ahead of the roadmap, translating upcoming releases into role-specific enablement before they reach the field

 Design and deliver launch enablement for new product features and capabilities, ensuring leaders, managers, and ICs are equipped to speak to and demonstrate them confidently

 Build and maintain a scalable product knowledge infrastructure including training materials, release notes for the field, and quick-reference guides that keeps the team current as the product evolves

 Serve as the go-to internal resource for questions about how DataSnipper works, what has changed, and how to position new capabilities

 Revenue Enablement Programs
 Design and deliver enablement programs that span the full revenue team including AEs, CSMs, SEs, and frontline managers, aligned to where they are in the customer lifecycle

 Build and run discovery, value realization, and objection-handling training that prepares the field for tough conversations with technical and finance buyers

 Develop and maintain playbooks, training workbooks, and enablement assets that provide consistent depth and are usable by a global team across time zones

 Measure the impact of enablement programs through clear metrics and use data to continuously improve quality, coverage, and field performance

 Cross-functional Collaboration
 Act as the primary point of contact between Product, PMM, and the Revenue org for all enablement-related alignment

 Build strong relationships with Revenue leaders and managers to surface gaps, gather feedback, and ensure enablement stays relevant

 Contribute to a culture of continuous learning across the Revenue organization

 
 What You Bring
 
 7+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, or a closely adjacent role within B2B SaaS

 Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team, with the ability to set direction, give feedback, and develop people

 Proven ability to work closely with Product and PMM to translate roadmap developments into field-ready enablement at pace

 Hands-on experience building enablement programs from scratch including training curricula, playbooks, and launch frameworks, not just delivering pre-made content

 Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to si

jobs.title: Social & Follower - Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.
  
 Your expedition: Product & Growth
  
 This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.
  
 While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers .
  
 The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature ) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.
 
 Your itinerary
 What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. 
 You will:
 Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

 Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

 Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

 Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

 Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

 Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

 
 The equipment in your backpack
 What we're hoping you'll bring with you. 
 ✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role
 ✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.
 ✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth
 ✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)
 ✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back
 ✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo
 ✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience
 
 1st class extras
 Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. 
 Salary range: Between EUR 70.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 85.000 - 95.000 (senior level) gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

 Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan

 A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here. 

 A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

 Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

 An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you). 

 Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

 The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG
 Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.
 The Role 
 The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.
 In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.
 The Impact You’ll Make 
 Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

 Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

 Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

 Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

 Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

 Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

 What Success Looks Like 
 Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

 Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

 Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

 Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

 Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

 What You Bring to the Table 
 Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

 Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

 Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

 Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

 Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

 Languages: Fluent in English and German.

 Why Join Wallee? 
 Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

 True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

 Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

 Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation , aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets , and a social calendar filled with events .

 The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.
