jobs.title: Web Analytics & Marketing Technology Lead (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.
 Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Wir suchen einen Web Analytics & Marketing Technology Lead , der die Verantwortung für unsere Website-Analyse und unser Onsite-Tracking übernimmt. Du hilfst uns zu verstehen, wer unsere Websites besucht, wie Nutzer mit unseren Inhalten und Lead-Strecken interagieren und was aus einem Besuch einen qualifizierten Lead und schließlich einen Kunden macht.
 Unsere Websites sind zentral für die Gewinnung und Ansprache unserer Kunden. Du stellst sicher, dass wir Website-Verhalten, Marketingaktivitäten und Vertriebsergebnisse zuverlässig miteinander verbinden – und diese Daten nutzen, um das Nutzererlebnis, die Lead-Qualität und unsere Kampagnenperformance zu verbessern.
 Diese Rolle bietet dir die Möglichkeit, praktische technische Arbeit mit analytischer Problemlösung zu verbinden und diesen Bereich innerhalb unseres Growth-Teams aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.
 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Übernimm die volle Verantwortung für Onsite-Tracking und Web Analytics über unsere Websites, Landingpages und Lead-Strecken hinweg.

 Implementiere, teste und betreue das Tracking zentraler Website-Interaktionen – von Seitenbesuchen und Content-Nutzung über Formularschritte und Abbrüche bis zur Lead-Registrierung.

 Analysiere, wie sich Besucher auf unseren Websites bewegen , identifiziere Hürden und Potenziale und verbessere gemeinsam mit Marketing, Product und CRO die Nutzerinteraktion und Conversion.

 Entwickle unsere Traffic-Attribution und Customer-Journey-Messung weiter, damit wir verstehen, welche Kanäle, Kampagnen und Touchpoints Nutzer auf unsere Websites bringen und zur Conversion beitragen.

 Verbinde Website-Verhalten mit CRM- und Kundendaten , um neue Besucher, Interessenten im Vertriebsprozess und Bestandskunden zu unterscheiden – soweit Identifikation und Einwilligung dies ermöglichen.

 Stelle sicher, dass Werbeplattformen zuverlässige Conversion- und Qualitätssignale erhalten – von Website-Interaktionen und Lead-Registrierungen bis zu Terminbuchungen, erfolgreichen Verkaufsgesprächen und Käufen.

 Arbeite mit Performance Marketing und Sales daran, zu verstehen, welcher Traffic und welches Onsite-Verhalten zu höherer Lead-Qualität führen , und nutze diese Erkenntnisse zur Verbesserung unserer Kundengewinnung.

 Sei die zentrale Ansprechperson für Website-Tracking und Messung : Steuere externe Partner, pflege die Dokumentation und entwickle Datenqualität und Consent Management kontinuierlich weiter.

 
 
 Dein Profil 
 Erfahrung in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics oder Marketing Technology , mit praktischer Verantwortung für Website-Tracking.

 Fundierte Kenntnisse in Google Tag Manager und GA4 , einschließlich Event-Tracking, Data Layers, Debugging und Qualitätssicherung.

 Eine analytische Denkweise und die Fähigkeit, Website- und Funnel-Daten in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen zu übersetzen.

 Ein solides technisches Verständnis, einschließlich JavaScript, HTML und der Funktionsweise der Datenerfassung und -übertragung auf Websites .

 Erfahrung mit Server-Side Tracking und Conversion-Tracking für Werbeplattformen , idealerweise mit Google Ads Enhanced Conversions oder Meta Conversions API.

 Verständnis für Attribution, Cookies und Consent Management , einschließlich der Grenzen des Trackings über Sessions und Geräte hinweg.

 Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kommunikationsstärke in der Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Analytics und Entwicklung.

 Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse ; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

 Nice to Have 
 SQL-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Website-Event-Daten in BigQuery, Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Plattformen.

 Erfahrung mit der Verknüpfung von Website-Tracking, CRM-Daten und Offline-Conversions .

 Berührungspunkte mit CRO, A/B-Testing oder Personalisierung .

 Erfahrung in Lead-Generation-Geschäftsmodellen mit längeren Vertriebszyklen .

 
 Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️
 
 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen 
 Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

 Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nation

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Software
jobs.description:
Company Overview 
 At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.
 
 The Role 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own how our device software behaves. You'll take the product vision and turn it into features our software team can build with confidence.
 This is product work at the level of detail. You'll think through how features should behave in every situation, including the edge cases, and give the team clear answers. You'll also make sure that work gets delivered. That means keeping the backlog in shape, setting priorities and following features through to release. You'll start on future releases of CoMind One, our first product, and help shape CoVision as it moves towards delivery. As the team and product line grow, so does the role.
 At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. 
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Define how features work, step by step, including the edge cases and failure modes that matter in a clinical setting.

 Package features for build: what it does, why it matters, what it looks like, and the decision logic behind it.

 Prototype flows and interactions using AI tools, so the team sees the idea before they build it.

 Sit with the software team and make the call when a feature question comes up.

 Act as the link between our commercial team and the software team, turning customer and market needs into clear requirements. Use quick prototypes to test those needs with customers and the commercial team before they reach the backlog.

 Shape the product roadmap with the Product Lead.

 Own the software backlog in Jira: intake, triage and grooming, so it reflects real priority.

 Write acceptance criteria and check that what ships matches what was intended.

 Partner with the Project Manager, who runs sprints, so sequencing and timing reflect real priority rather than convenience.

 Keep decisions and documentation in Confluence, not lost in Slack.

 AI is fundamental to our culture — it's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

 Skills & Experience: 
 Demonstrable product management experience on software that runs on physical hardware.

 You understand the pace of regulated hardware: long development cycles and infrequent releases.

 Evidence of making product decisions from logic and a deep understanding of users.

 Writing requirements precise enough for engineers to build without repeated back-and-forth.

 You're comfortable debating a feature with engineers and explaining why it matters for the product.

 A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

 You use AI tools heavily in your day-to-day work.

 Hands-on experience building interactive prototypes, using AI tools to turn an idea into something clickable that users and engineers can react to.

 Nice to have: 
 Medical device experience, or exposure to ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

 Software engineering or technical background.

 Experience with embedded or real-time software.

 Benefits: 
 Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

 Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

 Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

 Group life insurance at 4x annual income

 Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

 Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

 Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

 Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

 YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

 
 Disclaimer - We use Granola, an AI notetaker, throughout our interview process to help capture notes. It's used only for note-taking during the conversation. Transcripts aren't saved to shared drives or stored externally. Let us know if you'd prefer we don't. 
 Compensation: £80K – £110K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Tax and Recs (Europe)
jobs.description:
Hybrid role based in our London office (3 days a week)
  
 About us 
 Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.
  
 We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland.
  
 We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.
  
 We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.
  
 If you want to help build the next chapter of Seccl in Ireland and shape the future of investing across Europe, you’ll be in good company.
  
 Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.
  
 The role 
 We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Tax and Recs squad in our European tribe. You’ll own how we reconcile client cash and assets, and how we help our clients report their customers’ tax correctly, as we grow across Europe.
 
 Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Tax and Recs squad makes both possible: we can only grow if our reconciliations hold up under regulatory scrutiny and our tax engine is something clients can trust.
 
 You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. You’ll work closely with our Operations, Compliance and Customer teams, and with key European clients. A reliable tax engine is not just a regulatory necessity, it is a genuine advantage when we sell to new firms, so your work will be felt well beyond the squad.
 
 What you’ll own 
 Scaling our cash and stock reconciliations to meet Client Asset Requirements (CAR) in Ireland, so we can grow volumes with confidence

 Making sure our Operations team’s processes work in Europe and scale as we do

 Building the tax reporting and tax engine for Ireland, so our clients can report tax correctly on behalf of their customers across the wrappers that matter to Irish firms

 Localising that foundation to each wrapper and each country across Europe, rather than starting again every time

 Connecting directly to tax authorities where a country requires us to pay tax on behalf of our clients’ customers

 Making our tax engine reliable, transparent and easy to build on, so tax becomes a reason firms choose Seccl

 Defining and prioritising the Tax and Recs squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with what the next European markets will need

 Translating regulatory requirements, including CAR and Irish tax rules, into clear product requirements with Compliance

 Breaking down complex problems like localising a tax engine into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

 Using quantitative and qualitative data, such as break rates, exceptions and resolution times, to make evidence-based decisions
 

 This role’s for you if... 
 You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in reconciliations, custody, investment operations or tax in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions, insurance)

 You understand client money and money flow

 You’re comfortable operating in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments where structure doesn’t yet exist

 You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

 You’re highly proactive: you create momentum rather than wait for direction

 You’re customer-obsessed, with a focus on improving workflows and outcomes

 You thrive in cross-functional environments, working comfortably with Operations, Compliance, Customer and Engineering, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

 
 What’s in it for you 
 We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:
 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000 , reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contrib

jobs.title: Remote Sr. Product Manager - Revenue Management - 1 year contract (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️
 Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!
 We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 
 With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️
 Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 
 
 Your Role 
 As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.
 You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.
 
 What you'll do 
 Product Vision & Strategy 
 Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

 Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

 Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

 Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

 Discovery & Delivery 
 Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

 Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

 Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

 Impact & Influence 
 Define and own KPIs for your area, be clear about what moved them and why, and be honest about correlation vs. causation.

 Influence across teams without authority, especially where your area depends on other RM teams, Reporting and Integrations.

 
 Your Profile 
 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs.

 A track record of making complex systems radically simple

 Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

 Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

 Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing.

 You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

 You're a curious, structured thinker with strong product intuition.

 You can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship intact.

 You ask "why" until it's clear, and explain "how" until it clicks.

 You reflect honestly on what didn't work.

 
 What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Prediction Markets
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the team

Fans have opinions. Fanatics Markets lets them trade on them.

Fanatics connects 100M+ fans with around 900 sports partners across Commerce, Collectibles, and Betting & Gaming. We’re now building Fanatics Markets, and we want it to be the biggest and best prediction market for sports, sports culture, crypto and beyond.

Our core customer is a sports-first trader who is more likely to use Robinhood or Hyperliquid than a sportsbook. We’re building a suite of tools to give this customer the best possible trading experience from their phone. We have a small, high-performing team and a very flat structure to ensure the best ideas win.

About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager who is highly nimble and can solve a wide range of problems across the entire product stack. You’ll come in, understand the problem, define a solution, ship, iterate and move on to the next problem. Here are some example problems you might solve:

  • Building the best perpetual futures product for a sports-first trader

  • Building a “pro” trading mode for our best customers

  • Building industry-first tools that help traders make better decisions

  • Building new types of rewards and incentives for traders

  • Whatever else you come up with to drive trading volume and grow the business

What you’ll need

  • 2–6 years’ experience in Product Management

  • A love of numbers – you think in probabilities and make data-driven decisions

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Experience delivering amazing products to end customers

  • An entrepreneurial, high-ownership mindset

  • Comfort with basic trading concepts and familiar with top platforms like Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and Hyperliquid.

  • You move fast

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech  or building a trading product

  • A STEM background or quantitative degree

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Stablecoins & Payments
jobs.description:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

Canton Network is delivering what others promised but couldn’t: a blockchain for finance that actually works. As the only open layer 1 blockchain network with configurable privacy and controls sufficient for regulatory compliance, it is the venue where DeFi and TradFi are converging.

We are looking for a visionary Principal Product Manager to lead our Stablecoins & Onchain Payments product activation program. This is not just a "feature-owner" role, but rather you will be the architect of how stablecoins & payments move across the Canton Network.

As TradFi and DeFi converge, the demand for stable, regulatory-compliant and programmable units of value has never been higher. You will define and own the strategy for Digital Asset stablecoin & payments activation on the network, ensuring that stablecoin implementations and payment rails are not only technically superior but commercially dominant in contrast to other networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and validate sustainable stablecoin and payment use cases on the Canton network, that can be activated together with institutional partners.
  • Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for stablecoins (fiat-backed, RWA-backed) and payments activation on the Canton Network, involving a cross-functional team of stakeholders and network participants (e.g. Tier 1 Stablecoin & RWA asset issuers). 
  • Work with institutional partners to design workflows that connect legacy payment & PoS systems with Canton’s privacy-enabled ledger.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure payment initiatives meet global standards (e.g. MiCA, Basel III) while maintaining the privacy benefits of the Canton Network.
  • Ensure that the scaling of stablecoin and payment use cases focuses on high-availability, security and low-latency settlement.
  • Define and track Key Value Indicators (KVIs) for the use case activation on the network such as Mint/Burn volumes and Transaction Volume/Numbers.
  • Act as the primary product subject matter expert for stablecoins and payments use cases and activation within Digital Asset. 

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3 years focused on stablecoins and payments .
  • Proven track record of shipping products related to stablecoins use case intersecting with aspects of treasury management, cross-border payments, PoS provision or automated clearing houses (ACH)
  • Deep understanding of the stablecoin and payments stack.
  • Understanding of blockchain technology  is required and it would be great to have a familiarity with payments focussed layer 1/2 ecosystems
  • While not a developer, you can confidently discuss application architecture, smart contract logic, and settlement workflows with engineers.
  • Experience building for B2B or B2B2C environments where security, compliance and "five-nines" reliability are non-negotiable.
  • You are comfortable discussing business models, pricing strategies and tokenomics. 
  • BIG BONUS: Direct experience with the Canton Network, Daml, or building institutional-grade Stablecoin payment applications.

jobs.description:
Your Mission: 
 As Senior Project Manager – Grant Projects (all genders), you will lead the delivery of our multi-year, large-scale EU-Innovation Fund project CAROLUS for the industrialisation of VÆRIDION's Microliner, including the set-up of our first Final Assembly Line at Oberpfaffenhofen Airport. Positioned within Programme Management and working closely with Finance, you will translate grant commitments into an integrated delivery plan and ensure that milestones, deliverables, and funding obligations are met on time, within budget, and in line with EU funding rules. You will coordinate activities across engineering, certification, operations, finance, and external partners, and act as the main point of contact for the funding authority. Depending on capacity, you will also support further EU and national grant projects, from proposal preparation through to day-to-day project management.

 Lead our flagship industrialisation grant 
 Lead the end-to-end management of our CAROLUS grant project, from grant signature through industrialisation and entry into operation.

 Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, milestone schedule, and deliverable roadmap, aligned with the company's master schedule.

 Drive the completion of milestones and deliverables, ensuring that evidence is complete, consistent, and submitted on time.

 Establish and run project governance, including steering committee meetings, risk management, escalation, and change control processes.

 Coordinate engineering, certification, operations, and facility activities across internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Prepare periodic and annual reports, covering technical progress, emission reduction performance, and knowledge sharing.

 Act as the main point of contact for the funding authority, managing reporting obligations, communication, and grant amendments.

 Ensure compliance with funding, environmental, and visibility requirements, and maintain audit readiness throughout the project lifecycle.

 Manage running grant projects, including reporting, payment requests, partner coordination, and documentation

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

 5+ years of project management experience.

 Proven track record of managing milestone-driven projects and reporting to senior management.

 Solid understanding of budgets, payment plans, and financial reporting.

 Knowledge of lump sum EU funding or German national funding programmes is a plus.

 Experience with project management and planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar.

jobs.title: AI Project Manager
jobs.description:
ParetoLabs is looking for an experienced and structured (Senior) AI Project Manager to lead AI projects for our clients from first idea to production.
 As part of our dynamic team, you will be the link between our clients, our engineers and the AI technologies we build with. You will scope projects, steer delivery and make sure what we ship creates real value in Swiss companies across a wide range of industries.
 About ParetoLabs 
 ParetoLabs is a Zurich-based software studio that develops customized, AI-powered applications for conversational and text-processing use cases. We help companies quickly test, implement, and scale AI applications within their specific business environments.
 Founded in 2023, ParetoLabs is a Microsoft for Startups partner that combines innovative AI technologies with the individual requirements of Swiss companies.
 Tasks
 Lead AI projects end to end — retrieval assistants, copilots and agents — from discovery and scoping to rollout and operation.
 Translate business problems into clear use cases, requirements and success criteria together with our clients.
 Plan and steer delivery with our engineering team: scope, timeline, budget, risks and priorities.
 Define how quality is measured and make sure solutions are evaluated before and after go-live.
 Work with client stakeholders on data, security, compliance and change management.
 Collaborate closely with our multicultural team and bring your own ideas to projects with real-world impact.
 Requirements
 Experience: Several years of project management in software, data or digital transformation projects; AI or data projects are a strong plus.
 AI Understanding: A solid grasp of how large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and AI agents work, what they are good at and where they fail.
 Technical Foundation: Enough understanding of software architecture and cloud infrastructure (ideally Microsoft Azure) to discuss solutions with engineers and client IT and security teams.
 Methods: Confident with agile delivery and with structuring ambiguous problems into concrete plans.
 Stakeholder Management: Experience working with business and IT stakeholders up to management level, including managing expectations about what AI can and cannot do.
 Data & Compliance: Awareness of data protection (Swiss FADP, GDPR) and information security in client projects.
 Communication Skills: Excellent German and English, written and spoken.
 Mindset: Structured, hands-on and curious, with the ownership to bring projects over the finish line.
 Benefits
 Competitive Remuneration: A competitive salary package, reflecting your experience and contributions.
 Pick Your Gear: Choose your preferred devices for work.
 Attractive Benefits: above market pension benefits and a private accident insurance.
 Professional Growth: Participation in the Microsoft for Startups program, offering access to valuable resources, events and support.
 Interested in leading AI projects that make a real difference? We would be happy to hear from you.
 Please send us your CV and, if available, examples of projects you have led.
 Join ParetoLabs and shape how Swiss companies put AI to work!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.
 What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.
 In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
 And we’re a long way from done!

 THE ROLE 
 Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be. 
 We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. 
 This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. 
 If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Product Strategy & Execution: 
 Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why 

 Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value 

 Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour 

 Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics 

 Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

 
 Design & Engineering Partnership: 
 Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts 

 Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse 

 Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

 
 Cross-functional Leadership: 
 Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently 

 Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal 

 Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics 

 Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox 

 AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers 

 Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in 

 A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality 

 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products 

 Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 
 
 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 
 About the job 
 Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design. 
 
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there. 
 
 You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front. 
 
 You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them. 
 
 If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you. 
 
 Responsibilities
 
 Vision & Strategy 
 Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users. 

 Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it. 

 Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction. 

 Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage. 
 
 Technical Product Leadership 
 Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions. 

 Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

About Upsun

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

 We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

 In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

 Ready to spark your growth with us?

 WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 

 Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

 About the role 

 The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

 You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

 Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

 
 Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.

 Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.

 Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

 
 Business Cases and Strategy

 
 Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.

 Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.

 Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.

 Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

 
 Product Discovery and Delivery

 
 Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.

 Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.

 Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.

 Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

 
 Alignment and Stakeholder Management

 
 Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.

 Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.

 Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.

 Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

 
 WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄

 Must-haves

 
 Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.

 Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.

 High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.

 Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.

 Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.

 Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.

 A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

 
 👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you! 

 NICE TO HAVE 🎆

 
 Retail, CPG, or retail media background

jobs.title: Data Migration Project Manager
jobs.description:
À propos de Dastra
 Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA .
 Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle , en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.
 Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover , en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables .
 
 Le rôle
 En tant que Data Migration Project Manager , tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.
 À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client , ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %) , tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.
 
 Tes missions
 
 Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z
 Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

 Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

 Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

 Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

 Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

 
 Comprendre & structurer la data
 Analyser et structurer les données sources du client

 Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra

 Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

 Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

 Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

 Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration

 
 Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. 

About the Team

Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users.

The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.

Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth?

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products.

  • Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products.
  • Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions.
  • Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.
  • Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.
  • Can operate as a “conductor” — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo and Wolt, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.

From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.
 We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control , CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.
 Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.
 Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Product Vision and Strategy : execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.
 Stakeholder Collaboration : act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features. 
 Product Backlog Management : create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
 Development and Delivery : work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines. 
 Market and User Research : analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.
 Compliance and Risk Management : ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
 Performance Monitoring : monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators. 
 
 Why it's a good move ? 
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.
 Fundamentals to join us : 
 You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ; 

 You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory. 

 You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

 You speak French fluently.

 Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 
 

 From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
 

 As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
 

 Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
 

 We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!
 

 
 As Senior Product Manager in our Pro Business Unit, you'll own the mid-market product line end to end. You'll lead a "pod" - a small, cross-functional team of a PM or designer, and 2-3 full-stack engineers - through the whole cycle: identifying the problem, shaping the solution, building it, shipping it, and measuring the result. You're the single point of accountability for that team.
 The role blends product management, product design, and engineering judgment, all supported by AI tools. So we welcome candidates from a PM, design, or engineering background, as long as you're comfortable working across all three.
 You'll report into the Product Engineering director within the BU, alongside other pods led by senior PMs, designers, or engineering managers.

 

 Your impact at Brevo: 
 

 Gather client signals and usage data and translate them into clearly defined problems, then shape the pitch — appetite, solution, risks and no-gos — and defend it at the betting table.

 Act as the pod's sole design reference: frame the user experience, make interaction and interface decisions, and create prototypes in line with our Naos design system leveraging Claude or our in-house prototyping tool.

 Run the build cycle against the pitch, using lightweight written status artefacts rather than recurring status meetings, and adjust scope rather than extend timelines.

 Agree on one or two measurable outcomes before the build begins, then deliver a clear post-launch verdict: continue, adjust, or discontinue.

 Own the launch: run the beta programme, equip PMM for go-to-market, and get Sales, CSM and Support ready ahead of release.

 Be the pod's single point of contact for the wider BU — surfacing risks early, coordinating with peer Pod Leaders, and applying AI tools by default across discovery, prototyping and analysis.

 Who you are: 
 

 You have a relevant background as a PM or Product Designer, or Lead Engineer — no single track is preferred.

 You can own an experience end-to-end: framing user problems, making interface/interaction decisions, and producing or validating prototypes (Figma and design-system literacy required).

 You have a go-getter, get-things-done mentality: you take initiative, push through ambiguity, and drive things to completion rather than waiting to be told.

 You can write and defend a complete pitch: problem, appetite, sketch, rabbit holes, no-gos and success metrics.

 You have a track record of shipping against a committed appetite using lightweight, async cadence artefacts (e.g. hill charts) rather than heavyweight Scrum rituals.

 You're comfortable pulling and interpreting usage data (Amplitude, funnel, retention) and running discovery interviews to turn signals into problem statements.

 You're tech-credible: comfortable reading AI-generated code and partnering with a Lead Engineer on trade-offs — and you integrate AI tools by default into your day-to-day work, with a critical validation step on their outputs.

 You are fluent in English and in French

 Why people love working at Brevo: 
 

 
 A place to grow together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.

 
 Practical perks for everyday balance : RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package, and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

 
 Learning, every step of the way : Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

 
 Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure? 

 
 At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

 We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

 This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

 You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.

 About this role: 
 Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements 

 
 Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.

 Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.

 Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.

 Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.

 Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

 
 Bring the outside in 

 
 Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.

 Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.

 Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

 Decide and prioritize 

 
 Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.

 Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.

 Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.

 Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

 Communicate 

 
 Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.

 Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.

 Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

 
 
 Must Haves: 
 
 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management.

 Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense.

 Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology

 Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.

 Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.

 Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.

 High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan.
